## How Are Holographic Displays Used?

[Military hologram table]

Holograms and holographic images can be a game-changer for businesses in various industries. In
education, 3D holograms are enhancing classroom learning by enabling students to interact with
interactive holograms, such as anatomical models or historical figures through holographic displays.

In defence, virtual holograms aid in strategic planning, battlefield execution and review, and
advanced soldier training simulations.

For businesses in the entertainment industry—like theme parks, concerts, or immersive
exhibitions—holographic technology delivers unforgettable experiences with captivating interactive
holograms that engage audiences like never before.

Our holographic displays can also utilise photogrammetry, a technique that transcends traditional
boundaries by allowing virtual objects to come to life. Axiom’s holographic technology enables
architects and engineers to capture real-world structures and convert them into precise digital
models using 3D holograms. This allows for detailed analysis, accurate measurements, and seamless
integration with design software—resulting in enhanced efficiency and streamlined workflows.

Engineers can leverage virtual holograms to create prototypes, test structural integrity, and
optimise designs—minimising costs and reducing project timelines.

members to feel as if they’re in the same room. With our collaborative stage hologram technology,
participants can gather on a virtual stage, projected as life-sized 3D holograms, creating an
environment that mirrors face-to-face interactions.

Whether you’re hosting business meetings, educational seminars, or creative brainstorming sessions,
this holographic technology fosters seamless collaboration, genuine connection, and enhanced
productivity.

Through advanced motion capture and rendering techniques, our holographic displays reproduce the
subtlest human movements. Every gesture—from a reassuring smile to a decisive finger-waggle—is
faithfully conveyed, deepening the impact of communication.

Overall, the possibilities of using 3D holograms, virtual holograms, and interactive holograms are
vast—providing businesses with a competitive edge, improved customer experiences, and innovative,
forward-thinking solutions.

## How Are Holographic Displays Used?

[Military hologram table]

Holograms and holographic images can be a game-changer for businesses in various industries. In
education, 3D holograms are enhancing classroom learning by enabling students to interact with
interactive holograms, such as anatomical models or historical figures through holographic displays.

In defence, virtual holograms aid in strategic planning, battlefield execution and review, and
advanced soldier training simulations.

For businesses in the entertainment industry—like theme parks, concerts, or immersive
exhibitions—holographic technology delivers unforgettable experiences with captivating interactive
holograms that engage audiences like never before.

Our holographic displays can also utilise photogrammetry, a technique that transcends traditional
boundaries by allowing virtual objects to come to life. Axiom’s holographic technology enables
architects and engineers to capture real-world structures and convert them into precise digital
models using 3D holograms. This allows for detailed analysis, accurate measurements, and seamless
integration with design software—resulting in enhanced efficiency and streamlined workflows.

Engineers can leverage virtual holograms to create prototypes, test structural integrity, and
optimise designs—minimising costs and reducing project timelines.

[Hologram table display]
[Hologram table display]

Our holographic displays can also utilise photogrammetry, a technique that transcends traditional
boundaries by allowing virtual objects to come to life. Axiom’s holographic technology enables
architects and engineers to capture real-world structures and convert them into precise digital
models through photogrammetry. This allows for detailed analysis, accurate measurements, and
seamless integration with design software, resulting in enhanced efficiency and streamlined
workflows. Engineers can leverage photogrammetry to create virtual prototypes, test structural
integrity, and optimise designs, minimising costs and reducing project timelines.

[Army holographic solutions]

Additionally, businesses can use holograms for remote collaboration and communication, allowing team
members to feel as if they’re in the same room. With our collaborative stage hologram technology,
participants can gather on a virtual stage, projected as life-sized 3D holograms, creating an
environment that mirrors face-to-face interactions.

Whether you’re hosting business meetings, educational seminars, or creative brainstorming sessions,
this holographic technology fosters seamless collaboration, genuine connection, and enhanced
productivity.

Through advanced motion capture and rendering techniques, our holographic displays reproduce the
subtlest human movements. Every gesture—from a reassuring smile to a decisive finger-waggle—is
faithfully conveyed, deepening the impact of communication.

Overall, the possibilities of using 3D holograms, virtual holograms, and interactive holograms are
vast—providing businesses with a competitive edge, improved customer experiences, and innovative,
forward-thinking solutions.

[Hologram enclosure unit]
[Hologram enclosure unit]

Through advanced motion capture and rendering techniques, our hologram technology captures and
reproduces the subtlest details of human movement, enabling participants to convey emotions and
engage in natural conversations. From a reassuring smile to a firm finger-waggle, every non-verbal
cue is faithfully conveyed, enhancing the depth and richness of communication. Overall, the
possibilities of using holograms are vast and can provide businesses with a competitive edge,
improved customer experiences, and innovative solutions.

We participate in the project as a manufacturer, coordinating production activities based on the
technical and application requirements that the client has confirmed. Here’s how we work together to

conduct thorough acceptance tests.
● Mass Production: Upon sample approval, we start mass production, ensuring every product meets your
standards. All production processes are controlled to ensure quality.
● On-Time Delivery: Products are delivered to your designated location on time, following the agreed
schedule.
